# Proposal: Define observable cache invalidation

## Candidate and consequence

Define the observable behavior of cache invalidation so runtime consumers can
distinguish the relevant outcomes under a defined cache-owned semantic contract.

## Boundary and placement

The cache owner is the semantic-owner hypothesis; the minimal consumer-facing
observation contract may instead belong at a cache event surface or shared
telemetry boundary. Placement therefore remains uncertain. The proposal
excludes dashboard UI, generic telemetry-platform expansion, consumer-specific
UI, unrelated cache policy, and portfolio policy.

## Relationships

No relationship to another formed proposal is established in this outcome.
The packet originates from the bounded intake projection rather than the raw
idea collection.

## Uncertainty and evidence needs

Named intake evidence establishes assessment authority and the current
repository observation. Runtime-consumer inventory, current invalidation
behavior and event surfaces, consumer-required outcome distinctions, and
owner/interface evidence remain needed. Reopen the combined boundary if
observability has independent consumers, value, lifecycle, or ownership.

## Source provenance

The packet manifest references `projection.json`, which retains the exact
intake assessment, source revision, candidate, evidence, uncertainty, and
non-authorization state used during formation.

## Authority

This proposal is formed but not evaluated or accepted. It does not authorize
implementation or cleanup, settle permanent placement, or change roadmap
priority.
